result.summary: Found 2 issues: duplicate restaurant cards in the Fastest carousel and a restaurant name truncated in that same row.

issues.description: The Fastest near you carousel shows Green Bowl Poké twice in a row with the same image, delivery time, and price.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the restaurant list so each venue appears only once, or clearly differentiate locations/variants if both are intentional.

issues.description: The third Fastest card title is cut off as 'Smash Bros Bu' instead of showing the full restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a slightly smaller type size, or truncate with an ellipsis so the name remains readable.
